The expensive problem

You probably don't have a lead problem.

You may have a what-happens-after-the-lead-arrives problem.

An enquiry lands while you're on a job. A quote goes out Tuesday and you mean to chase it Thursday. Thursday becomes Monday. Then the customer disappears.

WHAT IS ONE DECENT JOB WORTH TO YOU?

£2,000? £5,000? £10,000?

TradeOS doesn't need to transform your business overnight to pay for itself. It may only need to stop one good customer disappearing.

The customer doesn't know you're busy. They only know who replied, who stayed in touch and who made it easiest to buy.

That's the leak TradeOS is built to close.

Why TradeOS exists

Big-business thinking. Built for a much simpler reality.

Before TradeOS, I spent years building ecommerce and digital systems for major businesses, then more than a decade consulting on large commercial platforms.

Those companies could afford teams whose job was to make sure the customer journey worked.

A TRADE BUSINESS DOESN'T HAVE THAT LUXURY.

Often the person answering the enquiry, quoting the job, doing the work and remembering to follow up is the same person.

After building systems individually and speaking directly with tradespeople about the same recurring problems, the obvious next step was to bring those pieces together.

That's TradeOS. A practical operating system designed around the way a small trade business actually works.
